additional_background: GIAB HG001 NA12878 NISTv4.2.1 GRCh38 autosomal benchmark
preparation: Use exactly the same existing frozen exon/flank rule, case/allele/phenotype selection and analysis. Do not combine genotypes across backgrounds. Report each background separately and paired case-level recovery in both.
denominator: Nine provisional autosomal source-label cases per background, not eighteen independent diseases or genomes from those patients. Retain PAX4 and the two X controls separately on each background.
reason: Check sensitivity to a different public genetic background before any observed outcomes; synthetic cases are not clinical validation.
